About

Free Signature Generator helps you draw or type a signature, download a transparent PNG, and place that signature on a PDF, all in your browser without uploading files.

Upstream project

This site is built on Sign PDF by Kristian Mario Miskovic (TekiDeki), licensed under Apache-2.0. We keep the LICENSE and NOTICE files and credit the original author. Vendored pdf-lib (MIT) and PDF.js (Apache-2.0) power PDF work in the browser.

Not a qualified signature

This is not a certified, qualified or certificate-based electronic signature. It is not equivalent to Adobe Sign, DocuSign, or an eIDAS qualified signature. You receive a visual signature on the page or a PNG file.
